messages:
incident-bot: Pager: P0 - Elevated 5xx rate on EU embeddings cluster (inference-eu-embed-*) detected. Alert id: A-4321. Paging oncall.sre.
sre-olivia: I'm taking this. Seeing KV cache OOMs on several embed workers, correlated with a recent model warmup spike.
sre-olivia: Starting rolling restart canary in eu-west-1 (host group embed-canary-1). Will watch 2 mins after restart.
jamie-pm: Need an initial status page blurb we can share externally + internal quick note for CS. Can someone draft?
emily-ops: Draft for status page (please review):
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for embeddings in the EU region affecting hosted embeddings requests. Impact: a subset of customers may see increased 5xx errors or request failures for embedding generation.
What we're doing: Engineers are performing rolling restarts of the EU embeddings worker pool and monitoring error rates.
Scope: Hosted embeddings in EU (eu-west-1). Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a mitigation update.
```
matt-cs: Add a short line for customers doing bulk/async jobs to retry with backoff. Also note Private unaffected.
sre-olivia: Confirmed: Private & Dedicated not impacted. Adding retry guidance is good.
jamie-pm: Minor wording suggestion: change "investigating" -> "identifying cause" only if we have conclusive root cause. For initial publish keep "investigating".
emily-ops: Updated draft below with retry note:
```
We are investigating elevated error rates for embeddings in the EU region affecting hosted embeddings requests.
Impact: Some hosted customers may experience increased 5xx errors when generating embeddings.
Mitigation: We are performing rolling restarts of the EU embeddings worker pool. If you are running large/async embedding jobs, please retry failed requests with exponential backoff.
Scope: Hosted embeddings in EU (eu-west-1). Dedicated and Private deployments are not impacted.
Next update: in 15 minutes or when we have a mitigation update.
```
incident-bot: Draft posted to #incidents-drafts: https://status-draft/review/A-4321
jamie-pm: Legal/ops ok with that phrasing? (cc @matt-cs)
matt-cs: Good to go from CS side. Will prepare impacted customer DM list after publish.
sre-olivia: Canary restarted - error rate for canary host down ~70% vs peak. Proceeding with staged rollout across remaining workers.
emily-ops: Suggest publishing initial "investigating" update now and follow up with a mitigation update referencing the canary improvement.
jamie-pm: I'll publish initial now and set automated follow-ups every 15 minutes.
emily-ops: Published initial incident update on status page (incident A-4321) :white_check_mark:
matt-cs: Kicking off customer outreach list for impacted accounts, will DM owners and include suggested text.
sre-olivia: Rollout complete. Error rates back to baseline across eu-west-1. Monitoring window active for 10m.
emily-ops: Drafting resolved note - will post once 10m stable. Draft: 
```
Resolved: The elevated error rates for embeddings in the EU region have been mitigated. We performed rolling restarts of the EU embeddings worker pool which restored normal service. No action required from customers. If you continue to see errors, please contact support and include request IDs.
Root cause: KV cache OOMs triggered by a transient warmup/traffic spike; engineering will follow up with a post-incident analysis.
```
jamie-pm: Nice. Matt, ping when customer messages are out.
matt-cs: Sent DMs to impacted accounts and posted a short note in the customer slack channel. Will attach statuspage link.
sre-olivia: Stable for 12m now. Go ahead with resolved publish.
emily-ops: Resolved notice published on status page (A-4321 resolved). Closing thread after postmortem schedule. :tada:
jamie-pm: Thanks all — great cross-team coordination.
